comment: PEDAL BUILD manifest for sForm (9-knob). A shapeable LFO written into the R channel, made as the key source for XDuck (Route KeyR). L passes untouched. Place it right before XDuck, Out=Link, XDuck Route=sForm. Params arrive as UI*0.01 (LineSel clones), so every knob keeps max <= 100. One value box (page knob 1), so each page starts with the knob whose value matters most: Wave, Skew, Out.
gid_comment: 0x01 = Dynamics category -> SONAME prefix ZDL_DYN_ (user's request 2026-10-19; was 0x08 Delay).
fxid_comment: 0x1f6. Changed 2026-10-19 (was 488, which collides with matujuice's Choral/EuGate). Free in stock, themanro dist and matujuice dist.
fxid_version_comment: Bump on every pedal build. History: C:\zoom\zdlnew\sForm_versions.txt.

params.name: Wave
params.comment: Sine, Tri, SawUp, SawDn, Square (duty = Skew: 50 = square, else pulse), S&H (random steps), Drift (smooth random).

params.name: Rate
params.comment: Base rate 0.1 .. 10.0 Hz in 0.1 Hz steps (UI r -> 0.1*(r+1); default 9 = 1.0 Hz). The pedal shows Hz.

params.name: Skew
params.comment: Symmetry: where the peak of Sine/Tri/Saw sits in the cycle; duty cycle of Square (50 = square, lower/higher = pulse).

params.name: Curve
params.comment: Bend of the 0..1 shape: <50 log (bulging), 50 linear, >50 exponential (snappy).

params.name: Smooth
params.comment: Output smoothing 0 .. ~200 ms (rounds the corners of Square/Pulse/S&H).

params.name: Out
params.comment: XDuck (R carries the LFO and its 180-degree copy for XDuck Route=sForm/sFPan; L untouched), Drone (R = input/synth mix by Depth, L untouched), DrnSt (both outputs = input/synth mix by Depth).

params.name: Depth
params.comment: Out=XDuck: LFO depth 0..1. Drone / DrnSt: mix, 0 = guitar only, 50 = guitar and synth both at full level, 100 = synth only.

params.name: Note
params.comment: Off = Rate x Mult. C0..A7 = the oscillator runs at that note (A4 = 440 Hz), Rate and Mult ignored. in-48, in-36, in-24, in-12, in, in+12, in+24 = the pitch tracked from IN L, shifted by octaves, held while the input is silent. max 101 is the largest proven: 0.16 with max 103 failed to install (FS.bin size mismatch). The DSP reads this knob as raw*100 (101 arrives as 1.01).
